resources.string: The first start installs everything (several GB): keep the phone charging and on Wi-Fi, it can take an hour or more.
Unsupported CPU architecture: %1$s (64-bit ARM or x86 required)
ebook2audiobook exited with code %1$d, see the log
Warning: only %1$d GB free, the full install needs about 15 GB.
Warning: %1$d GB of RAM, 8 GB or more is recommended (use light engines such as piper or vits).
This link cannot be downloaded from the app
A conversion can run for hours. Allow ebook2audiobook to ignore battery optimizations so Android does not stop it when the screen is off.

Android 12 and newer may kill the processes ebook2audiobook starts ("phantom process killer"), which stops conversions with no error.

Android 14+: Settings → Developer options → enable "Disable child process restrictions".

Android 12/13: from a computer run
adb shell "/system/bin/device_config put activity_manager max_phantom_processes 2147483647"
This deletes the Linux environment, ebook2audiobook, the downloaded models and every audiobook stored in the app, then installs again from scratch.
